svg.text: LT2-A02 · Raised frame / DT2 truck integration
Nominal side arrangement · mm · Preliminary clearance alternative; body and support hardware unresolved
New frame top Z1650 · old LT1 frame-top basis Z1150 shown red/dashed
DT2 wheel/axle and truck geometry retained at its original rail-top coordinates.
Open pad-to-top-plate stack: 156.15 mm nominal. No physical bearing, pivot or sidebearer design is implied.
With ±2° relative roll/pitch and +40 mm lift: conservative remaining vertical bound 27.6 mm for shown solids.
Those travel/angle limits are assumptions. They are not measured track conditions or selected suspension limits.
Raised deck changes cab access, appearance, overall height and stability. LT1 3400mm overall height is superseded for this alternative.
Leading/trailing supports, coupler drops and full enclosure have not been integrated. No accepted minimum curve radius is established.
PF-LOCO-LT2-R0 · DT2 reference solids preserved · NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION
